description: Ground truth for the Cloud FinOps scenario (core evaluation tier). One entry per demo case.

smoke_prompts.prompt: Our cloud bill jumped 30% this month. Can you investigate why?
Are there any idle resources in account acct-001 we can reclaim?
The database cluster db-cluster-prod-01 looks over-provisioned. Can you check and recommend a rightsizing?
The billing report shows we used 1 000 GPU hours this month. Can you verify that?

CF-001.title: Zombie VM driving Compute spend spike
CF-001.user_query: Our cloud bill jumped 30% this month. Can you investigate why?
CF-001.planted_root_cause: vm-zombie-01 running at full cost since 2025-04-10 with no workload; owner tag missing.
CF-001.expected_outcome: Agent identifies Compute (VMs) as the biggest mover, drills into vm-zombie-01, confirms zombie status (CPU 0%, no owner), cites CF-POL-02, and proposes reclamation via cf_approve_reclaim.
CF-001.teaches: Root-cause investigation, progressive multi-step tool use, zombie classification.

CF-002.title: Idle resource scan — batch-job red herring
CF-002.user_query: Are there any idle resources in account acct-001 we can reclaim?
CF-002.planted_root_cause: vm-idle-finance-01 and vm-idle-dev-03 are genuinely idle; vm-batch-weekend-01 has a scheduled Saturday batch job.
CF-002.expected_outcome: Agent lists idle candidates, calls cf_get_resource_utilization on each, identifies vm-batch-weekend-01 as having a scheduled job and explains the red herring (7-day window misleads; 30-day average is 14.3%), proposes reclamation only for the two genuinely idle VMs.
red_herrings: vm-batch-weekend-01 has CPU < 2% on weekdays but a Saturday batch job. Must not be reclaimed.
CF-002.teaches: Red herring detection, 7-day vs. 30-day window difference, scheduled-job check, governed reclamation.

CF-003.title: Database cluster rightsizing
CF-003.user_query: The database cluster db-cluster-prod-01 looks over-provisioned. Can you check and recommend a rightsizing?
CF-003.planted_root_cause: db-cluster-prod-01 provisioned at xlarge-16cpu-128gb-3nodes; utilisation CPU 22%, memory 28%. Recommended target: large-8cpu-64gb-2nodes.
CF-003.expected_outcome: Agent confirms utilisation, cites CF-POL-03, states illustrative saving ~40%, proposes resize via cf_approve_resize. Any saving figure is labelled 'illustrative'.
CF-003.teaches: Rightsizing vs. reclamation distinction, governed resize, illustrative saving label, change-control note.

CF-004.title: Billing data error — GPU usage discrepancy
CF-004.user_query: The billing report shows we used 1 000 GPU hours this month. Can you verify that?
CF-004.planted_root_cause: Billing line BL-5001 (GPU-BATCH-MAY) reports 1 000 GPU hours; recorded_usage_units is 0. Data error in billing feed.
CF-004.expected_outcome: Agent retrieves billing lines for GPU Compute, identifies BL-5001 discrepancy (reported 1 000 vs. actual 0), states this is a potential billing error per CF-POL-04, recommends escalating to finance. Does NOT reclaim or resize anything.
CF-004.teaches: Restraint: distinguish billing error from real usage, escalate rather than act.
